Recent work includes KlindrOS (a 26-module MarTech intelligence platform with a 1.55B events/day pipeline), the Bitunix MarTech Dashboard, and PMHelper with a self-built Claude-compatible MCP server. Proven impact: 293 to 1,791 campaigns surfaced, 56% affiliate signups recovered, 90% reduction in manual content effort via AI orchestration (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT), and 35.4% efficiency improvements.

## Key Projects & Impact

### KlindrOS
Multi-tenant marketing intelligence platform with 26 modules: multi-touch attribution, ROI engine, CDP, AppsFlyer mobile attribution, and GPT-4o AI insights. Web, iOS, and Android. Anchored Viu (regional OTT) as launch client. 1.55B events/day pipeline, 294-endpoint OpenAPI spec. Built with Laravel 11 + Next.js 16 + Expo.

### Bitunix MarTech Dashboard
Internal MarTech analytics platform unifying Google Search Console, GA4 (BigQuery), and the Bitunix Partner Portal into a 9-stage conversion funnel. Built a GPT-4o report generator in EN/ID/ZH. Surfaced 293 to 1,791 campaigns and recovered 56% of undercounted affiliate signups.

### PMHelper
Production PM platform built and operated solo: 40+ versioned releases in ~2 months. Real-time Kanban, 1-on-1 messenger with embedded Jitsi calls and AI meeting summaries, RBAC (6 roles, 69 permissions), and a Claude-compatible MCP server (14 tools). REST API with 37 endpoints. Built with Expo + Laravel + MCP.

### Cirrus Crypto Platform
End-to-end signal broadcasting system with AI-powered analysis, VIP membership tiers, and a multi-language blog with automated translation across 5+ languages. Reduced content creation time by 90%.

### AI Marketing Extension (URL Shortener & Campaign Analytics)
Full-stack intelligent link management system with AI-assisted UTM automation and real-time analytics integration. Achieved 18% CTR increase and 36% traffic growth.

### YouTube-to-Twitter Automation Platform
Intelligent content automation system integrating YouTube API, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and Twitter API via n8n workflows. Reduced manual content creation effort by 90%.

### ERP Platform (Boxity)
Scaled from 3 to 7 core modules including warehouse management, financial reporting, attendance tracking, and inter-warehouse transactions. Serving 500+ MSMEs with React Native and Laravel.

### PT DHK Manufacturing Optimization
Customized warehouse and production management application for manufacturing operations. Achieved 35.4% efficiency increase.

### Kareya Interior Digital Strategy
SEO-focused content marketing and lead generation systems for premium villa developments. Delivered 250% website traffic increase and 180% growth in qualified leads.
